command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

# Same two inputs as recipes/mash: the spades (237 contigs) and megahit (1 contig)
# assemblies of identical reads -- the same ~400kb region built two ways, so highly
# similar. sourmash uses FracMinHash (scaled), a DIFFERENT MinHash variant from mash's
# bottom-sketch, so its NUMBER differs from mash's (Jaccard similarity vs a distance);
# the two tools AGREE qualitatively (both call the pair near-identical), not on the raw
# value. See README.
echo "== sourmash similarity: spades assembly vs megahit assembly =="
sourmash sketch dna -p k=31,scaled=1000 spades_contigs.fa -o spades.sig
sourmash sketch dna -p k=31,scaled=1000 megahit_contigs.fa -o megahit.sig
sourmash compare spades.sig megahit.sig --csv compare.csv
cat compare.csv

# The off-diagonal of the 2x2 compare matrix is the Jaccard similarity.
JACC=$(awk -F, 'NR==2{print $2}' compare.csv)
{
  echo "sourmash_jaccard   $JACC   want >= 0.95   (same ~400kb region, two assemblers; observed 0.99282)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

# Method-justified threshold: FracMinHash Jaccard of two assemblies of identical sequence
# approaches 1; a broken sketch or mismatched pair collapses far below 0.95. Not shaved.
awk -v j="$JACC" 'BEGIN{ if (j+0 >= 0.95 && j+0 <= 1.0) exit 0; print "sourmash jaccard " j " not >= 0.95"; exit 1 }'
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
